The campaign story

Why Christmas?

For many of the families we walk with, December is the heaviest month: the cold, the heating bills, school closing, the loneliness of the holidays. It is also when a simple gesture counts the most.

Where your gift goes

Catalogue gifts are bought locally, prepared by our volunteers and handed over in person during December outreach and distributions. If an item is already covered, your gift goes to the most pressing need in the same area.

“Whoever is kind to the poor lends to YHWH.”

Proverbs 19:17
